confirmed.title: ESC with the Undercroft backpack open opens the pause box instead of closing the backpack; the v8.95 ESC branch is unreachable
confirmed.why: The backpack is a canvas panel, not a .modal, so the v8.70 pause branch sees nothing open and fires first, returning before line 9422 (`if(hubBagOpen){ hubBagOpenSet(false); ...`) can run. The player presses ESC to close the backpack and instead gets a PAUSED box (with its textarea focused) drawn over the still-open backpack; a second ESC closes the pause box and the backpack is still up. ESC never closes the backpack on the floor, contradicting the comment on line 9421 and the raid's own ESC behaviour.

confirmed.title: 'Equip as your gun' in the right-click menu throws on an undefined variable after removing the gun from the stash
